title: GDPR personal data export
tasks: gdpr data export for a user

requirements.text: Only the signed-in data subject (recently re-authenticated) or an authorized admin can request an export, within their tenant
The export includes all personal data from every source in a declared data inventory (profile, content, activity, consents)
Other people's personal data is excluded or redacted
The export is machine-readable (JSON or CSV), and CSV cells cannot run as spreadsheet formulas
Exports are built by a background job that survives retries and notifies the user when ready
The download is available only through a tamper-proof, expiring link or an authenticated route
Generated archives are deleted after the download window
Requests and downloads are recorded for accountability

evidence.name: csv-safe: writeCsv vector, neutralization and validation

implementations.notes: Formula-safe RFC 4180 CSV writer; assembling the export is the app's work

evidence.name: signed-urls: byte-exact vectors, expiry, tampering and malformed input

implementations.notes: HMAC-signed expiring URLs; the link is a bearer credential, so pair it with an authenticated route when needed
pg-boss worker lifecycle and retries; export generation and notification are the app's handlers

notes: No Genlib package implements the export workflow or a data inventory; only formatting, link and job building blocks exist.
